title: Large-Area Sample Preparation: Advancing Solutions for Engineering and Industrial Materials Analysis
content: One of the most critical aspects of materials science is the preparation of high-quality samples for microstructural characterization. Engineering industries such as aerospace, automotive, nuclear, and lithium battery development often require large, complex samples, which present unique challenges in sample preparation. The preparation process must preserve the native structure of the material without introducing contamination, oxidation, or induced structural damage. This is essential for obtaining meaningful data [1, 2].
